text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*...!
Ugh... I'm so stupid, stupid!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Of all days, being late on Christmas...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry!
Thank you for waiting...!
choice_data_list: I haven't been waiting long, so don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
W-Well then, let us be off...!
Um... I've done plenty of research beforehand!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Th-Th-Th... This is... the place with the 'Insta-worthy' illuminations...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh? There are so many, which one is it?!
There are too many people, I can't see properly...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Eek!?

"Zenno Rob Roy is almost swept away by the surging crowd.
To keep from being separated, I reflexively grabbed her hand."
choice_data_list: Let's head over where it's less crowded!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, I'm so sorry...
I had no idea it would be this crowded..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Even so, Trainer's hand—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
They were so cold...
...You've been waiting out here the whole time...
choice_data_list: Is something wrong with my hand?
Is something wrong with my hand?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Um, well...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
They say people with cold hands have warm hearts...
I realized that's not just something in fairy tales.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"W-Wah...!
W-Wait, Trainer...!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
My glasses fogged up because we suddenly
came into such a warm room—

Looking closely, her lenses were completely fogged white,
making it look difficult for her to see anything properly.
choice_data_list: There should've been a drugstore back there...

text_block_list.text:
Having Zenno Rob Roy wait by the wall,
I hurried off to buy some anti-fog wipes for her glasses.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much...!
Right now, I feel like I could even eat piping hot ramen inside an ice castle...!
choice_data_list: I'm glad I was able to help.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Trainer, you always clear away the clouds over my heart.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
She pointed the way forward, saying "this way,"
and stayed by my side whenever I was feeling down...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The reason I can still keep striving to be a hero like this,
without ever wavering, is because I had you supporting me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: So, um—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I'll make good use of the anti-fog spray!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Because this is the Christmas present
you gave me, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um, about the anti-fog spray
you gave me earlier—
choice_data_list: Wait, wait! I have another present for you!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh!?
Ah, I-I'm sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Um, I brought a gift as well... Shall we exchange presents properly a bit later?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Both the anti-fog spray and that gift...
I will treasure them both.
Though it was a Christmas marked by minor mishaps, I was able to make unforgettable memories together with Zenno Rob Roy.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I thought I'd get you a present
to show my daily gratitude, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"It's a leather book cover and bookmark, but...
well... the design is—"
choice_data_list: Is it modeled after Rob Roy? It's so cute!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes! The hero I look up to—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh? Cute?
choice_data_list: That's the green from Rob Roy's racing outfit, right?
That's the green from Rob Roy's racing outfit, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
No, that's wr-wrong...!
That's 'Rob Roy' the folk hero, it has nothing to do with—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you're right... No, it's the same green, but,
um, that's not it...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I bought it hoping that 'Rob Roy' would watch over you, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
And yet... it's like I'm saying 'I'll watch over you'—
ugh, that's so embarrassing...!
choice_data_list: If Rob Roy is watching over me, I feel like I can do anything.
It's reassuring to know you're watching over me, Rob Roy.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Is that... so...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... It might be much more reassuring
with two people rather than just one...!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I'm still nowhere near 'Rob Roy,' but I've gotten a little stronger too...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
So as expected... with 'Rob Roy' and
myself as the motifs—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "Because you have two heroes... right by your side, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Merry Christmas,
Trainer.
Together with a shyly smiling Zenno Rob Roy, I spent a heartwarming Christmas.
